Title: EventRelay Home Dashboard
Context: A modern video intelligence dashboard for developers called EventRelay.
Description of the screen: Home screen for EventRelay video analysis app in dark mode. Two-column layout. Left column: A clean dashboard overview with high-level stats (videos processed, API usage, total events detected) using glassmorphic cards on a deep slate background. Right column: A 'Recent Activity' feed showing a list of recently analyzed videos with thumbnails, status badges (Processing, Completed), and quick-action buttons. Accents in Electric Violet and Cyan Pulse.
Platform: ios
Form factor: phone

Title: EventRelay Workspace Home
Context: A modern video intelligence dashboard for developers called EventRelay.
Description of the screen: Home screen variant for EventRelay. Two-column layout. Left column: A primary navigation and project selector with a prominent 'New Analysis' button in Electric Violet. Right column: A large, feature-rich workspace area featuring a 'Drag and Drop' upload zone and a 'Paste YouTube URL' input field, both styled with Cyan Pulse borders and glassmorphism. Navigation at the bottom features Home, Projects, Analytics, and Settings.
Platform: ios
Form factor: phone
